# measure peak RSS of the service on the biggest inputs
import json, sys, resource, time, io, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import stress6, stress5

def run(req, label):
    data = json.dumps(req).encode()
    r_in, w_in = os.pipe()
    r_out, w_out = os.pipe()
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        os.dup2(r_in, 0); os.dup2(w_out, 1)
        os.close(r_out); os.close(w_in)
        os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'])
    os.close(r_in); os.close(w_out)
    t0 = time.time()
    # write in a thread to avoid deadlock
    import threading
    def feed():
        try:
            os.write(w_in, data)
        finally:
            os.close(w_in)
    th = threading.Thread(target=feed); th.start()
    out = b''
    while True:
        chunk = os.read(r_out, 1 << 20)
        if not chunk: break
        out += chunk
    th.join(); os.close(r_out)
    _, status, usage = os.wait4(pid, 0)
    print('%s: bytes=%d wall=%.2fs peak_rss=%.1f MiB out=%d bytes' % (
        label, len(data), time.time()-t0, usage.ru_maxrss/1024.0, len(out)))

run(stress6.build(), 'stress6 (2.5MB, 32 fields)')
run(stress5.build(), 'stress5 (1MB, heavy atoms)')
run(stress5.build(always_true=True), 'stress5 always-true')
EOF
